result.document_summary: A mid-document fragment of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 3 (Business Regulations), covering firearm trigger locks, money exchange houses and holistic health practitioners, with no residential rental provisions.
result.notes:
This part (65 of 364) contains only police-regulated business provisions: firearm dealer trigger locks (
g33.4212), Money Exchange Houses (Div. 43) and Holistic Health Practitioners (Div. 44). The source URL slug refers to a Division 11 prohibition of anti-competitive automated rent price fixing (
g98.1103), but none of that text appears in this part, so no algorithmic rent-setting rule can be extracted from it. Nothing in the six rental-law categories is stated here, so the list is empty.
